name: Chennai
notes: Illustrative configuration built from NDMA heatwave guidelines and IMD criteria; replace thresholds and duties with the city's own Heat Action Plan (Plans -> import PDF).
Coastal city: thresholds use IMD's coastal heatwave criterion (max >= 37 C) and are illustrative.
Zones are named localities ~8-12 km apart, matching the ~9 km resolution of the forecast models. They are not municipal wards.
The hot-night threshold is illustrative and should be set by the city.
To avoid alert fatigue, departments are tasked only once the plan is active (yellow tier or above); workers get a WBGT push alert from band 2 on any day.
Worker messages are Hindi and English for now; local-language messages (Tamil / Bengali / Telugu / Marathi) are on the roadmap.

actions.text: Set up drinking-water points at labour nakas, markets and construction sites in {zone}, {start}-{end}.
actions.ref: NDMA heatwave guidelines: drinking water at worksites and public places

actions.text: Ask contractors in {zone} to stop heavy outdoor work during {start}-{end} and reschedule to cooler hours.
actions.ref: NDMA heatwave guidelines: rescheduling outdoor work

actions.text: Open cooling shelters / shaded rest areas in {zone}, {start}-{end}, and publish their locations.
Alert hospitals and health centres serving {zone}; stock ORS, ice packs and IV fluids before {start}.
actions.ref: NDMA heatwave guidelines: health facility preparedness

actions.text: Deploy mobile medical / heat-relief teams to hotspots in {zone}, {start}-{end}.
actions.ref: NDMA heatwave guidelines: emergency response on red alert

reference_event.text: Humid pre-monsoon heat in Tamil Nadu, April-May 2024. Check IMD station values before quoting a number.

rights.en: NDMA heatwave guidelines ask employers to move heavy outdoor work to cooler hours and provide water, shade and rest. Ask your contractor for these.
rights.hi: NDMA दिशानिर्देश: भारी बाहरी काम ठंडे घंटों में करवाया जाए और पानी, छाँव व आराम दिया जाए। अपने ठेकेदार से यह माँगें।
